ei.title: 7번: The Mongoose as a Snake Predator
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Snakes are feared by humans and most animals. There is, however, one animal that does not fear them at all — the mongoose. Not only is it unafraid of snakes, but it also hunts them as prey. The thick fur of the mongoose helps protect it from snake bites, and so does its quickness. It is capable of moving at speeds of more than 30 kph. This, along with its slender body, gives it a great advantage when fighting snakes. Not only can it avoid the jaws of most snake species, but it can also survive when it does get bitten. Rare indeed is the snake venom powerful enough to kill an adult mongoose. The mongoose also has 28 sharp teeth, and it can bite with enough force to crack bones. It fights snakes by focusing on the head, often defeating them by smashing their skull.

questions.passage: Snakes are feared by humans and most animals. There is, however, one animal that does not fear them at all — the mongoose. Not only is it (A)[unafraid / afraid] of snakes, but it also hunts them as prey. The thick fur of the mongoose helps protect it from snake bites, and so does its quickness. It is capable of moving at speeds of more than 30 kph. This, along with its slender body, gives it a great (B)[advantage / weakness] when fighting snakes. Not only can it avoid the jaws of most snake species, but it can also survive when it does get bitten. Rare indeed is the snake venom powerful enough to kill an adult mongoose. The mongoose also has 28 (C)[dull / sharp] teeth, and it can bite with enough force to crack bones. It fights snakes by focusing on the head, often defeating them by smashing their skull.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) unafraid=두려워하지 않는 / afraid=두려워하는 (B) advantage=이점, 유리함 / weakness=약점 (C) sharp=날카로운 / dull=무딘
det.analysis:
① afraid—advantage—sharp: (A) 뱀을 사냥하는 몽구스라 '두려워하지 않는(unafraid)'이 맞음
② unafraid—advantage—sharp: 뱀을 '두려워하지 않고(unafraid)' + 날렵한 몸이 '이점(advantage)'을 주고 + '날카로운(sharp)' 이빨 ←정답
③ unafraid—weakness—dull: (B)(C) 날렵함은 '이점(advantage)'이고 이빨은 '날카로움(sharp)'
④ afraid—advantage—dull: (A)(C) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: unafraid(두려워하지 않는) 몽구스, advantage(이점), sharp(날카로운) 이빨

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) quickness=재빠름 / slowness=느림 (B) survive=살아남다 / die=죽다 (C) defeating=물리치는 / saving=구해주는
det.analysis:
① slowness—survive—defeating: (A) 몽구스를 보호하는 것은 '재빠름(quickness)'임
② quickness—die—saving: (B)(C) 물려도 '살아남고(survive)', 뱀을 '물리침(defeating)'
③ quickness—survive—defeating: 두꺼운 털과 '재빠름(quickness)'이 보호 + 물려도 '살아남음(survive)' + 뱀을 '물리침(defeating)' ←정답
④ slowness—survive—saving: (A)(C) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: quickness(재빠름)가 보호, survive(살아남다), defeating(물리치다) 뱀

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) slender=날씬한 / bulky=덩치 큰 (B) powerful=강력한 / weak=약한 (C) crack=깨부수다 / heal=치료하다
det.analysis:
① bulky—powerful—crack: (A) 뱀과 싸울 때 유리한 것은 '날씬한(slender)' 몸임
② slender—weak—heal: (B)(C) 몽구스를 죽일 만큼 '강력한(powerful)' 독, 뼈를 '깨부수는(crack)' 힘
③ bulky—powerful—heal: (A)(C) 문맥과 반대
④ slender—powerful—crack: '날씬한(slender)' 몸이 이점 + 몽구스를 죽일 만큼 '강력한(powerful)' 독은 드묾 + 뼈를 '깨부술(crack)' 힘 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①이 문맥상 부적절해요. 원문은 unafraid(두려워하지 않는)인데 afraid(두려워하는)로 바뀌었어요. ② protect=보호하다 ③ avoid=피하다 ④ sharp=날카로운
det.analysis:
① afraid: 뱀을 '두려워한다(afraid)'? 뱀을 사냥한다고 했으니 '두려워하지 않는(unafraid)'이 원문 ←정답
② protect: 두꺼운 털이 물림으로부터 '보호함(protect)' — 적절

det.analysis:

det.analysis:

② protect: 두꺼운 털이 물림에서 '보호함(protect)' — 적절

② (A) 군대 (B) 강요하다: (A) 이빨로 무는 '힘(force)'이라 '군대'는 어색
③ (A) 힘 (B) 군대: (B) 왕에게 무언가를 하게 하는 것은 '강요하다(force)'라 '군대'는 어색
④ (A) 힘 (B) 강요하다: 뼈를 깨부술 '힘(force)', 왕에게 양위를 '강요하다(force)' ←정답
det.tip: force의 다의어: (물리적) 힘 vs (억지로) 강요하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the bony structure of the head that protects the brain"

det.korean: skull=두개골 / jaw=턱 / fur=털 / tooth=이빨
det.analysis:
① skull: 뇌를 보호하는 머리의 뼈 구조 ←정답
② jaw: 턱 — 입을 여닫는 부분이라 정의와 다름
③ fur: 털 — 뼈 구조가 아님
④ tooth: 이빨 — 뇌를 보호하는 구조가 아님
det.tip: the bony structure of the head that protects the brain → skull(두개골)

questions.passage: The thick fur of the mongoose helps protect it from snake bites, and so does its quickness. It is capable of __________ (move) at speeds of more than 30 kph.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: move(움직이다) → moving. 'be capable of'의 of는 전치사라 뒤에 동사가 오면 동명사(-ing)로 써요.
det.analysis: move를 moving으로 바꿔요. 'be capable of'의 of는 전치사라, 뒤에 동사가 오면 동명사(-ing) 형태가 필요해요. 그래서 'capable of moving'이 돼요.
det.tip: be capable of + 동명사(-ing) → moving

questions.passage: This, along with its slender body, gives it a great advantage when fighting snakes. Not only can it avoid the jaws of most snake species, but it can also survive when it does get __________ (bite).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: bite(물다) → bitten. 'get + 과거분사'는 '~되다'라는 수동의 의미예요. bite의 과거분사는 불규칙 변화로 bitten이에요.
det.analysis: bite를 bitten으로 바꿔요. 'get bitten'은 '물리다'라는 뜻으로, get 다음에 과거분사가 와서 수동의 의미를 나타내요. bite는 bite-bit-bitten으로 불규칙 변화해요.
det.tip: get + 과거분사(수동) / bite-bit-bitten → bitten

questions.passage: Snakes are feared by humans and most animals. There is, however, one animal that does not fear them at all — the mongoose. Not only is it unafraid of snakes, but it also hunts them as prey. The thick fur of the mongoose helps protect it from snake bites, and so does its quickness. It is capable of moving at speeds of more than 30 kph. This, along with its slender body, gives it a great advantage when fighting snakes. Not only can it avoid the jaws of most snake species, but it can also survive when it does get bitten. Rare indeed is the snake venom powerful enough to kill an adult mongoose. The mongoose also has 28 sharp teeth, and it can bite with enough force to crack bones. It fights snakes by __________, often defeating them by smashing their skull.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: hiding under the ground=땅속에 숨기 / focusing on the head=머리에 집중하기 / running away quickly=재빨리 도망치기 / avoiding all snakes=모든 뱀을 피하기
det.analysis:
① hiding under the ground: 땅속에 숨기? 뱀과 싸운다는 흐름과 반대
② focusing on the head: 두개골을 박살 내 물리친다고 했으니 '머리에 집중(focusing on the head)'이 맞음 ←정답
③ running away quickly: 재빨리 도망치기? 싸워서 물리친다는 내용과 반대
④ avoiding all snakes: 모든 뱀을 피하기? 뱀을 사냥·공격한다는 흐름과 반대
det.tip: by ___, defeating them by smashing their skull → focusing on the head(머리에 집중)

questions.passage: Snakes are feared by humans and most animals. There is, however, one animal that does not fear them at all — the mongoose. Not only is it unafraid of snakes, but it also hunts them as prey. The thick fur of the mongoose __________, and so does its quickness. It is capable of moving at speeds of more than 30 kph. This, along with its slender body, gives it a great advantage when fighting snakes. Not only can it avoid the jaws of most snake species, but it can also survive when it does get bitten. Rare indeed is the snake venom powerful enough to kill an adult mongoose. The mongoose also has 28 sharp teeth, and it can bite with enough force to crack bones. It fights snakes by focusing on the head, often defeating them by smashing their skull.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: makes it easy to catch=쉽게 잡히게 하다 / slows down its movement=움직임을 느리게 하다 / helps protect it from snake bites=뱀에 물리는 것으로부터 보호해 주다 / attracts other predators=다른 포식자를 끌어들이다
det.analysis:
① makes it easy to catch: 쉽게 잡히게? 털이 몽구스에게 불리하다는 뜻이라 반대
② slows down its movement: 움직임을 느리게? 뒤에 재빠름을 말하므로 모순
③ helps protect it from snake bites: 두꺼운 털과 재빠름이 함께 '물림으로부터 보호(helps protect it from snake bites)'함 ←정답
④ attracts other predators: 다른 포식자를 끌어들이기? 문맥과 무관
det.tip: thick fur ___, and so does its quickness → helps protect it from snake bites(물림 방지)

ch: helps protect it from snake bites
